verdict.rationale: Bento documents broadcasts as one-time marketing sends to a broad audience or saved segment, and says campaigns can be created and scheduled with explicit audience rules (bento-docs-34, bento-docs-38). Audience selection is backed by saved segments and a custom segment builder (bento-docs-42, bento-docs-26), and broadcasts can also be created through the CLI and MCP (bento-docs-49, bento-docs-5). Missing for 10: documentation of the email composition/editor experience beyond reusable templates, an explicit immediate send-now path for broadcasts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the campaign send loop.
